title: Postmortem: Smart-routing fallback loop caused cross-region reroute + wrong model-variant selection
creator: Aisha Karim
description: Summary: On 2026-03-11 at ~22:40 UTC a customer-facing capacity event triggered smart-routing fallbacks. A combination of a policy mismatch in fallback_policy_v2 and an edge-case in the routerd region-loop detector caused traffic to oscillate between eu-west and us-east, and in several cases the runtime selected an incompatible model variant (quantized-v2) for requests pinned to fp16 variants. Impact: ~12 minutes of elevated latency and ~1.2% error rate spike for hosted customers using model family rwd-3b; two customers reported degraded responses. Root cause: 1) fallback_policy_v2 included a rule that attempted to map unavailable fp16 variants to the nearest available variant by name prefix, but did not validate compatibility matrix (quantized vs fp16). 2) routerd region loop protection mis-evaluated sticky routing buckets when cross-region failover and canary rollouts overlapped, allowing requests to be bounced between regions until capacity stabilized. 3) lack of pre-deployment invariant tests for variant compatibility and inadequate telemetry on variant mismatch rejections. Action items: - hotfix: revert fallback_policy_v2 to fallback_policy_v1 rules while we patch validation (owner: Marco Liu, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routerd/pull/1429) - add compatibility check in the model variant mapper that enforces architecture + quantization compatibility before fallback (owner: Priya Desai, target runtime-1.22) - implement region-loop guard enhancements in routerd to detect oscillation faster and sticky-hold traffic for a configurable cooldown (owner: Evan Brooks) - add unit + e2e tests to CI for variant compatibility matrix and cross-region failover scenarios (owner: Marco Liu) - backfill increased telemetry: counters for "variant_mismatch", per-request selected_variant, and a tracing span when failover triggers; surface in Console incident dashboard (owner: Observability team, ticket OBS-912) - customer comms: outreach to affected customers with incident summary and mitigation steps (owner: Customer Success)
comments: 2026-03-12 09:15 UTC - Aisha: Initial incident triage: rolled back fallback_policy_v2 on routerd and opened ENG-5503 for follow-ups. Noted two customer reports and internal dashboard showing error spike. Logged the incident as INC-2026-0311-4.

2026-03-12 12:02 UTC - Marco: Deployed revert PR to routerd (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/routerd/pull/1429). Latency returned to baseline within ~3 minutes of rollback. Still seeing sparse logs indicating attempted variant substitution leading to model load failures (runtime errors showing incompatibility).

2026-03-12 15:40 UTC - Priya: Reproduced the mismatch locally. The mapper uses simple prefix rewrite: 'rwd-3b-fp16' -> 'rwd-3b-quantized-v2' when fp16 missing. New validation will check ModelCatalog metadata field 'format' and 'dtype'.

2026-03-13 08:30 UTC - Evan: Routerd change: region-loop detector currently uses a 10s window; proposing to reduce window to 2s and introduce per-request sticky_id with cooldown 30s. Draft design in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Routerd+Cross-Region+Loop+Mitigation

2026-03-13 16:12 UTC - Observability: Dashboard ticket created OBS-912 to add variant_mismatch counter and an incident dashboard widget. Linked Grafana temp dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/incident-routing/variant-mismatch

2026-03-14 10:05 UTC - Marco: WIP PR for variant validation and tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2037. Tests include three compatibility matrices and one synthetic cross-region failover integration test. Requesting early review from Model Onboarding (Priya) and Runtime (Evan).
